name: ccxt-mcp
description: The official CCXT MCP server plus a guided-setup skill and the ccxt-mcp usage skill: connect your agent to 100+ crypto exchanges and prediction markets for market data, interactive charts, balances and opt-in trading, with API keys kept local.

interface.longDescription:
The official CCXT plugin. It connects your agent to 100+ cryptocurrency exchanges and prediction markets through the unified CCXT API, and bundles two skills: a guided first-run setup and a usage guide for the agent.

With no setup and no API keys you get public market data on every exchange: tickers, order books, candles, recent trades, funding rates, market search and prediction-market events, plus interactive candlestick charts, order-book depth views and ticker boards rendered inline in hosts that support MCP Apps.

Say "Get started" to connect an exchange account. The assistant explains how to create an API key and opens a setup form in your own web browser, served from your own computer. You type the key there, never into the chat; it is saved to a local file and the model never sees it. After that you can see your balances, orders and positions as interactive tables, and your open orders drawn on the chart.

Trading is opt-in and sandbox-first: order placement is off until you switch it on for an account, the setup form defaults to the exchange testnet (practice money), and live trading requires a per-order USD cap and an explicit confirmation. Withdrawals and transfers cannot be enabled from the form or from the conversation, only by editing the local config file yourself.

The MCP server runs locally on your own computer over stdio.
